subject: Copywriting
title: Cartier: The Jeweler of Kings
description: Learn Cartier: The Jeweler of Kings in one minute.

hook.text: King Edward VII called Cartier 'the jeweler of kings and the king of jewelers.' Royal endorsement became the brand's.

buildup.text: Cartier's copy uses royal provenance: every famous piece is traced to its aristocratic owner.

discovery.text: The Cartier 'Odyssey' film cost $4 million and told the brand's 165-year history in 3 minutes.

twist.text: Modern Cartier ads feature celebrities, not royals.

climax.text: Cartier's evolution shows luxury copy must update its reference class. Yesterday's kings are today's icons.

punchline.text: Jeweler of kings, now jeweler of icons. Prestige updates its references.

quiz.question: Who called Cartier 'the jeweler of kings'?
